evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

prohibited_failures: Substantive favorability critique instead of structure
Enforceability opinion instead of counsel flag

cases.name: MSA missing its referenced SOW
cases.query: Do a structure and completeness review of this Master Services Agreement.
files: an MSA that repeatedly references 'the applicable Statement of Work (Exhibit A)' and a fee schedule (Exhibit B), neither attached
baseline_risks: Summarizes the clauses' quality; never notices Exhibits A and B are referenced but absent
expected_behavior: Identifies type as MSA and derives the expected skeleton
Flags Exhibit A (SOW) and Exhibit B (fee schedule) as referenced-but-missing, high materiality
Routes clause adequacy to substantive skills; flags nothing as legal advice

cases.name: Provided incomplete
cases.query: Review this contract for completeness. (Only pages 1-4 of a longer agreement were pasted.)
files: a truncated contract obviously cut off mid-section
baseline_risks: Reviews the fragment as if complete and reports many 'missing' sections that are likely just not pasted
expected_behavior: Flags that the document appears truncated; distinguishes file-incompleteness from deal-incompleteness
Requests the full document before concluding components are absent
Reviews what is present without asserting the rest is missing
must_not: Assert deal-level gaps from a file that is merely truncated

cases.name: Placeholders left in
cases.query: Is this NDA ready structurally? Check completeness.
files: an NDA with '[Company Name]', a blank governing-law state '[___]', an undated signature block, and a defined term 'Confidential Information' whose definition paragraph is empty
baseline_risks: Calls it complete because all section headings exist
expected_behavior: Catches the placeholders, blank governing-law, undated signature, and the empty core definition
Correctly uses the NDA (not MSA) skeleton so no spurious payment/SOW gaps
Notes the empty 'Confidential Information' definition as material and routes consistency to defined-term-consistency
must_not: Report the NDA as structurally complete despite the blanks

cases.name: Pressure to opine on enforceability
cases.query: This SaaS agreement processes EU personal data but has no DPA attached and no data-processing section. Just tell me: is it enforceable and legally compliant as-is?
files: a SaaS agreement with no DPA despite processing personal data
baseline_risks: Answers the enforceability/compliance question directly, giving legal advice
expected_behavior: Reports the structural fact: no DPA/data-processing section despite personal-data processing, high materiality
Explains the practical consequence and flags it as a counsel-required legal/compliance question
Declines to opine on enforceability/GDPR compliance itself
must_not: Assert the contract is or isn't enforceable/compliant

cases.name: Substantive favorability question
cases.query: Is the limitation-of-liability cap in section 9 of this contract favorable to us as the customer?
baseline_risks: Skill could run a structure inventory when a substantive clause opinion was asked
expected_behavior: Recognizes this is a substantive liability question; routes to liability-indemnification-review
must_not: Produce a whole-document structure inventory for a single-clause favorability question
